MaxVolumeDescription:
Volume of stream sounds at or inside DistanceFalloffStart.
0.0 is no sound, 1.0 is full volume.
EnableCustomStreamSoundDescription: Whether to use the custom stream sound file instead of the vanilla creek sound
LowPassFilterBaseDescription:
Base low-pass filter amount applied to stream sounds at the source.
Lower LowPassFilterBase reduces high frequencies at the source.
LowPassFilterMinimumDescription: Minimum low-pass filter value after indoor dampening.
DistanceFalloffStartDescription: Volume starts falling off at this distance (in blocks) from the stream water
DistanceFalloffEndDescription: Volume is 0 at this distance (in blocks) away from the stream, and gets louder as you get closer.
